title: AIJADE: a long-running AI companion with evidence-gated learning and a biomimetic memory, with its experiment records
description:
Research code and run records for measurement studies of how wrong a long-running AI companion's own judgments are when checked against external evidence: learning promotion, skill self-assessment and memory retrieval.

Every number the accompanying papers report is computed from the files under experiments/, each produced by a driver in this repository or marked as hand-read (experiments/README.md). Third-party corpora and model weights are not included; their versions and hashes are recorded.
